biggest_catch: Bonus value (estimated ~$840 for 70,000 TrueBlue points at 1.2¢ each) minus the $99 annual fee = ~$741 first-year net; only pursue it with spending already planned.
catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.
The bonus requires BOTH $1,000 in purchases AND paying the $99 annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days.
The $99 annual fee is not waived in the first year.
TrueBlue points are revenue-based and do not transfer to other programs — their ceiling value is capped.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
